verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP server registry, so comparing servers by quality signals is a fair question for it. The evidence covers only server pages, search, and publishing flows (smithery-docs-23, smithery-gh-1). Nothing documents usage counts, health or liveness checks, quality scores, or verification badges. The community security scan of 'top 100' servers is third-party analysis, not a signal Smithery publishes, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compare servers using published quality signals — usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges
